results.title: دراسة: العلاج المبكر للكوليسترول قد يخفض خطر الخرف لدى مرضى السكري
results.description: أظهرت دراسة علمية حديثة أن البدء المبكر في تناول أدوية خفض الكوليسترول قد يرتبط بانخفاض خطر الإصابة بالخرف لدى مرضى السكري من النوع الثاني بنسبة تصل إلى 15%.ونشرت مجلة «The Lancet Regional Health – Europe» العلمية، أمس (الأحد)، نتائج الدراسة التي أجراها باحثون في مستشفى جامعة كوبنهاغن، وشملت بيانات 132585 شخصاً مصاباً بداء السكري من النوع الثاني، جرت متابعتهم بين 2006 و2021.ووجد الباحثون أن الأشخاص الذين بدأوا العلاج بخافضات الكوليسترول مبكراً انخفض لديهم خطر الإصابة بالخرف بنسبة 15% خلال 10 سنوات، مقارنة بـ10% لدى من بدأوا العلاج في وقت لاحق.وخلال فترة الدراسة، أصيب 2.7% من المشاركين بالخرف، فيما جاءت النتائج متشابهة بين الرجال والنساء.وأشارت الدراسة إلى أن خفض مستويات الكوليسترول والمحافظة على صحة الأوعية الدموية قد يكونان من العوامل المرتبطة بانخفاض خطر الإصابة بالخرف، خصوصاً لدى مرضى السكري من النوع الثاني.ولفت الباحثون إلى أن الدراسة رصدية، ما يعني أن نتائجها تظهر وجود ارتباط بين استخدام خافضات الكوليسترول وانخفاض خطر الخرف، لكنها لا تثبت أن هذه الأدوية كانت السبب المباشر في تراجع الخطر.
creator: «عكاظ» (كوبنهاغن)

results.title: AU10TIX and NEO Partner to Bring Real-Time Identity Verification to High-Volume Venues
results.description: Partnership helps gaming, wagering, hospitality, and travel operators automate identity checks, reduce manual review, and accelerate compliant self-service experiences MELBOURNE, Australia , Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AU10TIX, a global identity verification and fraud intelligence company trusted by enterprises worldwide, today announced a partnership with NEO, a leading global provider of self-service terminal technology and automation solutions, to bring real-time identity verification, age assurance, fraud prevention, and compliance capabilities into physical self-service environments. The partnership combines NEO's self-service terminal infrastructure with AU10TIX's AI-powered identity verification technology, helping operators verify identity, confirm age eligibility, detect fraud, and support compliance directly within the self-service journey. AU10TIX and NEO are already working together on live customer deployments with leading Australian gaming and hospitality venues, where real-time identity verification supports high-volume self-service guest journeys. The initial focus will be Australia, with plans to expand into Asia, the United States, Europe, and other global markets. In high-volume venues, every manual identity check adds friction. AU10TIX and NEO help operators bring real-time identity verification into the point of service - across onboarding, re-verification, card reissuance, access, and age-restricted transactions - while meeting the lighting, capture, positioning, hardware, and speed demands of real-world terminal environments. "As more customer journeys move to self-service, identity verification has to move with them," said Yair Tal, CEO of AU10TIX. "Our partnership with NEO brings AU10TIX's real-time identity intelligence into physical environments where speed, accuracy, and compliance all matter. This is about helping operators verify customers, assess risk, and prevent fraud directly in the flow, without sending people back to a manual process." By embedding AU10TIX's technology into NEO's self-service terminals, operators can run document verification, biometric matching, liveness detection, age assurance, and fraud checks directly inside the terminal workflow. The partnership also helps operators reduce operational friction. Identity verification workflows can be completed up to 10 times faster than traditional manual workflows. For example, card replacement or reissuance processes that previously took 30 to 40 minutes can now be completed in a few minutes through a streamlined self-service experience. "NEO's focus has always been on making self-service faster, simpler, and more effective for operators and their customers," said Anton Jovanovic, CEO of NEO. "By partnering with AU10TIX, we can add trusted identity verification, age assurance, and fraud prevention directly into the terminal experience. That means operators can complete processes that once took 30 or 40 minutes in just a few minutes, while still meeting the compliance standards their industries require." Together, AU10TIX and NEO are helping operators turn physical self-service into a trusted, automated customer experience. About AU10TIX AU10TIX is a global leader in identity management and fraud intelligence, dedicated to enhancing trust, safety, and compliance for businesses worldwide. Founded in 2002 in the Netherlands, with offices in London, New York, Singapore, and R&D centers in Israel and Eastern Europe, AU10TIX safeguards the world's most trusted brands through world-class automation, sophisticated fraud prevention, and advanced identity verification solutions. AU10TIX's future-proof product portfolio enables seamless customer onboarding and verification in seconds, while proactively adapting to emerging threats and regulatory demands. AU10TIX offers the industry's only 100% automated global identity management system and can detect organized mass fraud attacks by analyzing traffic patterns and cross-referencing data across a consortium of over 60 leading companies. With deep roots in airport security, AU10TIX has authenticated billions of identities and prevented over $33 billion in identity fraud. Connect with AU10TIX on LinkedIn . For more information, visit AU10TIX.com . About NEO NEO is a global leader in self-service technology, supporting millions of interactions every day. Since 1987, the Australian-founded company has designed and delivered high-volume terminal and automation platforms for major organisations across international markets. Its integrated capabilities span industrial design, engineering, software, systems integration, manufacturing and lifecycle support, enabling NEO to take complex self-service programs from concept through large-scale deployment. NEO solutions operate in demanding environments across aviation, government, healthcare, retail and wagering and gaming, where security, compliance, uptime and ease of use are critical. For more, visit neoproductsgroup.com or connect on LinkedIn .
